findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_current_user · Private data: get_current_user, get_prepaid_balance, list_contact_countries, list_contact_states, create_contact, get_contact, list_contacts, list_domain_registration_contacts, assign_domain_registration_contact_roles, remove_domain_registration_contact_roles, register_domain, get_domain_status, update_registrant_contact, configure_dns_record, list_dns_records, add_dns_record, update_dns_record, delete_dns_record, get_transfer_auth_code, reconcile_domains, create_customer, get_customer · Public sink: get_domain_audit_log, get_current_user, update_registrant_contact · Destructive: remove_domain_registration_contact_roles, delete_dns_record.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_current_user · Private data: get_current_user, get_prepaid_balance, list_contact_countries, list_contact_states, create_contact, get_contact, list_contacts, list_domain_registration_contacts, assign_domain_registration_contact_roles, remove_domain_registration_contact_roles, register_domain, get_domain_status, update_registrant_contact, configure_dns_record, list_dns_records, add_dns_record, update_dns_record, delete_dns_record, get_transfer_auth_code, reconcile_domains, create_customer, get_customer · Public sink: get_domain_audit_log, get_current_user, update_registrant_contact · Destructive: remove_domain_registration_contact_roles, delete_dns_record

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
